claims.claim: Transmission Gearbox M278 1282 OEM, Mercedes G63
claims.evidence: Label on casing in Photo 0 shows only partial number '460' and is illegible; witness could not confirm make/model or OEM part number.
No video of the unit running, no bench-test clip, no fluid/shift test shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Actual vehicle/engine fitment (is it genuinely an M278/G63 unit) cannot be confirmed from the blurred label.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the full legible casing tag/part number, plus a chassis or engine code photo from the donor vehicle if available.
risks.if_unproven: price as generic unidentified automatic transmission core, not as confirmed Mercedes G63 M278 unit

risks.risk: Internal condition (clutches, bands, solenoids, torque converter lock-up) unknown; could be worn or failed.
risks.proof: Video of unit being turned over/tested on a stand, or a dealer/mechanic inspection report with fluid condition noted.

risks.risk: Fluid leaks or contamination not visible from exterior-only shots; oil staining on nearby wall is suspicious.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seals, pan gasket, and a drained fluid sample photo showing color/metal shavings.
risks.if_unproven: price assuming possible leak/damage, not leak-free

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history and reason for removal (accident, failure, trade-in) unknown.
risks.proof: Odometer photo of donor vehicle or service/removal record.
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown-history used unit, high-mileage assumption

risks.risk: Electronic compatibility (wiring harness, solenoid pack, TCU pairing) may not match buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: Close-up of wiring harness connector pinout and solenoid pack part numbers.
risks.if_unproven: price as connector/electronics unconfirmed, may require adapter or reflash

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the full casing ID label/part number plate
Video of the transmission being tested (e.g., spun on a bench, torque converter engagement check)
Photos of all fluid ports/seals showing no leakage, and a fluid sample
Photo of the donor vehicle's VIN plate or engine bay to confirm it was pulled from a genuine M278 G63
Close-up of wiring harness connectors and solenoid pack
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an automatic transmission assembly with torque converter, so it can be priced at worst case as an unidentified, untested used core pending proof of model, fitment, and internal condition.
